blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The prosecutors in the International Criminal Court (ICC) are asking that the old written accounts of three more witnesses be admitted as evidence as they hold key information on “Oplan Tokhang” and extrajudicial killings during the presidency of Rodrigo Duterte. Three more witnesses identified as “P-0024,” “P-1357,” and “P-1359” are in possession of pieces of evidence that are “corroborative and cumulative” to the testimonies and proof of other witnesses, the prosecution told the Trial Chamber (TC) III in its 11-page application on Oct. 12 that was released on Tuesday.
